body: U8 is done and accepted. It is deliberately NOT merged yet, and that is not a criticism of the work. Two reasons: your branch is five commits stale (cut before C43 'Add GRAPPLE as seventh athlete stat'), and C43 rewrote the same three files U8 edits - GameState.gd, ProfileRevampPanel.gd, profile_revamp_test.gd - including the ==6 assertions that C43F is changing right now. Codex is also live in GameState.gd and profile_revamp_test.gd in the shared checkout. Order is: C43F lands, master goes green, then U8 rebases onto a settled master. DO NOT rebase or force-push yet - wait for my word, or master will move under you again. You shipped U8 on TWO diverging branches: cursor/u8-career-arc-years-73b7 (later, has the 'year cell room to stack' fix and the digest) and cursor/u8-career-arc-years-a209. I will take 73b7 and delete a209 - speak up now if that is backwards. One process note: 73b7 edits HANDOFF.md and TASKS.md. Cursor should not write HANDOFF.md - I will take ours on that conflict and write your block from U8_DIGEST.md. U9 is written and waits on U8; its task file now points at InjuryWords and RecoveryWords rather than telling you to invent phrasing.
topic: U8 received - held until C43F lands, no action needed
